cohort: 1311 births at Kirakira Hospital in Solomon Islands between 2014 and 2016
finding: Kirakira Hospital had a high perinatal mortality rate (31 per 1000 births), three times higher than Australia's rate, and a very low cesarean section rate (1.1%).
mod_finding: This study found a very high perinatal mortality rate in Kirakira Hospital, Solomon Islands, which was three times higher than the rate in Australia and double the rate reported for the Solomon Islands in World Health Organization data, with only 1.1% of deliveries being cesarean sections compared to 32.1% in Australia.
